zh: 在运行机上打开 FULI，看到的就是主机的复利：页面、操作和实时更新都经配对通道过去。
运行机打开 FULI.app 或运行 fuli setup 不会再自己建一套 FULI，主机连不上时会说明并显示排队的记录。
en: Opening FULI on a runner shows the host's FULI: pages, actions and live updates go over the pairing.
FULI.app and fuli setup no longer give a runner its own FULI; a page says when the host is away.
